name: capcut_add_keyframe
description: Adds an animation keyframe for scale, rotation, translation (x, y), or opacity to a video segment.

time_offset_seconds.description: Time offset from segment start in seconds (e.g. 0.0 for start, 1.5 for mid-clip).

value.description: Value at keyframe (e.g. scale 1.2, x 0.1, alpha 0.5).
